- Simply bumping SETUP_CONTRACT or adding memory to a global required-skill set would invalidate older receipts and license semantics.

### Planned verification

- Inspect all SETUP_CONTRACT equality and global REQUIRED_SKILLS uses for prior-edition compatibility.
- Run new/create, existing/prepare, interrupted stages and equivalent-rerun fixture checks without registering disposable products in the real depot.
